source.reference_agents: backend/env/agents.py and backend/env/policy.py, played on this episode

episode.rule: the first 12 overpasses at or after the requested start with a detection in the box
episode.chosen_from: MODIS rows only (VIIRS is hidden and was dropped before choosing)
episode.looks_note: one slot per pass of a hidden platform whose swath holds the whole box, from NASA CMR granule metadata: the time the scan crossed the box and the pixel size there, both from the swath polygon. Nothing is read from the hidden rows. A pass with no hidden detection is scored as a look that flagged nothing; VIIRS granules carry no cloud information and MODIS cloud cover is a granule mean, so such a look may have been cloudy.
episode.reward: the score after the look minus the score before it, on one fixed set: every real hidden detection of the episode. The rewards of a round add up to the score at the end minus the score at the start. A look that hands over no hidden pixel earns nothing.

grid.order: row-major; row 0 is the northern row, column 0 the western column

estimate.encoding: p_burning_u8: the model's probability that a cell burns, times 255 and rounded, one byte per cell, base64; tile_of_cell_u8: the tile of every cell, one byte per cell, base64. Tile t is row t // columns and column t % columns of the split, row 0 northern

reference_status: computed in the background; served when the round ends

test_episodes.reward: the first reward: each look was paid the change in the score on the detections still hidden after it. That scoring set shrank with every look, so the rewards of a round did not add up to the change in its score: a mean gain in this table is a sum of such rewards, not the final score minus the starting score.
test_episodes.empty_look: a look that revealed nothing was unknown and paid nothing (nominal looks)
test_episodes.plainly: On the test episodes under protocol version 2 the learned policy does not differ from least sure by more than the noise, and it is not better.

validation_reference.reward: the score after the look minus the score before it, on one fixed set: every real hidden detection of the episode. The rewards of a round add up to the score at the end minus the score at the start. A look that hands over no hidden pixel earns nothing.
validation_reference.spending: a player that does not choose when to look spends the budget on the same looks as every other such player, spread evenly over the episode, and only the tile differs. least_sure_at_night, least_sure_when_unsure and least_sure_when_sharp choose when, and so does learned; learned_tiles_only is its tile choice on the evenly spread looks

known_limits: FIRMS lists detections, not where a satellite looked and saw nothing, and has no cloud mask: a revealed tile with no detection may have been cloudy rather than free of fire. So a look that hands over no detection is taken as unknown: it teaches the model nothing and earns nothing. The looks are the passes of each VIIRS platform whose swath held the whole box, from NASA's pass list, at their real times and pixel sizes; a pass that held only part of the box is not a look.

protocol.name: sealed hidden rows, schedule from the pass list, empty passes scored
protocol.note: second look at the three 2021 test fires: a protocol correction. Episodes are chosen from MODIS rows alone; looks are nominal slots; the policy weights are those fitted under version 1, not refitted.
